ValidationRule.description: [Sheet row 47 / OppVR67] Opportunity Products cannot be added/edited/deleted once the parent Opp is in BV/Booked/Setup/Closed/Lost. Built on OpportunityLineItem. Approved by IRM, no change.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT(OR( $Permission.Sales_Operations_Bypass, $Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass )),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Opportunity.StageName, 'Booking Verification'), ISPICKVAL(Opportunity.StageName, 'Booked'), ISPICKVAL(Opportunity.StageName, 'Setup'), ISPICKVAL(Opportunity.StageName, 'Closed'), ISPICKVAL(Opportunity.StageName, 'Lost') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Insufficient permissions. Opportunity Products cannot be updated. Please contact your regional Sales Operations Business Partner for assistance.
